course.title: Compiler Design
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: Suppose a desk calculator reads an input line containing an arithmetic expression involving (10) digits, parentheses, the operators ‘+’ and ‘\*’ followed by a dollar (\$) sign and prints the value of the expression.
i) Write down the syntax directed definition for the calculator.
ii) Draw the annotated parse tree for the input $3 * . 5 + 4 * 9 \mathbb { S } .$

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2016
